37     if position < 0 || position > gb.size {                                                                          
36         return                                                                                                       
35     }                                                                                                                
34     if position < gb.gap {                                                                                           
33         for i := position; i < gb.gap; i++ {                                                                         
32             gb.data[i], gb.data[i+gb.gap-position] = gb.data[i+gb.gap-position], gb.data[i]                          
31         }                                                                                                            
30     } else {                                                                                                         
29         for i := gb.gap; i < position; i++ {                                                                         
28             gb.data[i-gb.gap+position] = gb.data[i]                                                                  
27         }                                                                                                            
26     }                                                                                                                
25     gb.gap = position                                                                                                
24 }                                                                                                                    
23                                                                                                                      
22 func (gb *GapBuffer) Delete(start, end int) {                                                                        
21     if start < 0 || end > gb.size || start >= end {                                                                  
20         return                                                                                                       
19     }                                                                                                                
18     copy(gb.data[start:], gb.data[end:gb.size])                                                                      
17     gb.size -= (end - start)                                                                                         
16     gb.gap -= (end - start)                                                                                          
15 }                                                                                                                    
14                                                                                                                      
13 func (gb *GapBuffer) Insert(runes []rune) {                                                                          
12     for _, r := range runes {                                                                                        
11         if gb.size < len(gb.data) {                                                                                  
10             gb.data[gb.gap] = r                                                                                      
 9             gb.gap++                                                                                                 
 8             gb.size++                                                                                                
 7         }                                                                                                            
 6     }                                                                                                                
 5 }                                                                                                                    
 4                                                                                                                      
 3 func (gb *GapBuffer) String() string {                                                                               
 2     return string(gb.data[:gb.size])                                                                                 
 1 }
